notes.title: Final Update for 2023
notes.content: This will be the last update of the year we want to thank everyone for their support we have a lot of special surprises for 2024. Parts Unknown will be around for a very long time we are establishing the proper relationships to create longevity.

notes.title: Leaderboard and rep update
notes.content: Special cash prizes will be rewarded for the top 10 players on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Parts Unknown location update
notes.content: We noticed there was a slight lag at the Parts Unknown location. We have removed a few things from the location to decrease the lag issue. We are working hard to create a great experience for everyone.

notes.title: Rep coin system update
notes.content:
Your rep is now tied to your Steam account! We have been working overtime to ensure that your data is saved no matter the device you have! We are now ready to expand rapidly. We noticed few bad reviews concerning the ReadyPlayerMe website. We want to ensure everyone that ReadyPlayerMe is a legit platform I will leave a link to the ReadyPlayerME about page below. Please remember that we are trying to create the Metaverse and that will consist of us integrating with platforms regularly. We want to thank everyone for their support!


ReadyPlayerMe about page - https://readyplayer.me/company/about-us

notes.title: Tackling update
notes.content: Each fighting style has a unique tackling animation. While running press "Q" to tackle opponents. Use the focus feature to make tackling easier. We have a new fighting style coming soon "Jeet Kune Do" all the animation will be done by professionals.

notes.title: Fighting style update!
notes.content: All fighting styles have been updated you will notice each fighting style has a unique set of animations. We have began to work with dancers to incorporate dancing animations mix with fighting animations. Our goal is to add every fighting style that exists to the game. We need your support please purchase rep coins so we can continue to add authentic animations to the game.

notes.title: Grapple Update
notes.content: We noticed an issue with the grapple move while using Windows PC. The issue has been addressed in this update. We want to thank everyone for their patience.

notes.title: Major update
notes.content: Revamped the fighting Halloween event coming soon.

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content: The online map has just gotten bigger! NPC's have been upgraded with more random animations. New Locations and fighting styles will be available soon. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content: Online has been updated the fighting is so much more fluid now we have the online event coming up on Saturday 9/23/2023 we have more fighting styles that will be available online soon as well as new locations to fight. ReadyPlayerMe has updated their software you can now customize your shoes, shirt, and pants individually and also create your own clothing via blender! We have more updates coming every week we appreciate everyone's support!

notes.title: Online Update
notes.content: Added more moves to the online fighting we are working with artists to add more fighting styles, artwork, and music to the game. Unknown Beach will be available soon.

notes.title: Fight Update
notes.content: We are currently only focused on online mode. Use the focus feature to attack enemies when online. We have new furniture and artwork coming for the apartment so be sure to rack up the Rep points online. We want to thank everyone for supporting this independent project!

notes.title: Major Online Update!
notes.content: Brand new power ups and obstacles online! We will continue to update the apartment more updates coming soon! 50$ grand prizes are still available online. We appreciate everyones support!

notes.title: Online Update!
notes.content:
New events will be added online frequently! Explore around and see what's new! Cash prize for best outfit on the runway take a screenshot of your outfit and send to partsunknown2023@gmail.com

Other updates made:

1. Fixed camera in story mode

2. Expanded map in online mode

3. Real animations coming soon via deep motion

notes.title: Story mode update
notes.content: There was an issue with the NPC's in story mode this has now been fixed we are still working on a way to integrate ReadyPlayerMe into online. The event coming up will have a cash prize along with a championship belt and Nacho Libre mask. I want to thank everyone for playing the game let's continue to build the online community.

notes.title: Story Mode Patch
notes.content: Fixed the fighting in story mode. Im dedicated to making this game the best ever for you all. Thanks so much for the support.

notes.title: Online Revamp
notes.content:
Improved online combat (more hit animations and camera shake on successful punch)

Improved online map and sound

notes.title: Map Update
notes.content: The online map just got bigger! we will continue to update online multiplayer.

notes.title: Online Map update (cars)
notes.content: The online map is much bigger now we have also added cars so you can drive around the map. The map will continue to get larger

notes.title: Online Patch
notes.content: If you experience issues joining a room please restart the game. You can fight anyone who joins the room or team up with them its up to you! Weapon upgrades will be available soon and character creation for online is coming soon also.

notes.title: Fight update
notes.content: Fighting mechanics are being patched everyday for a better experience please let us know if you have any problems we will be sure to correct it right away please keep in mind that we are building this game for the long term and it will eventually be more than just a fighting game and fully integrated with the Metaverse.

notes.title: New Side Mission/ Fight update
notes.content: There is a new side mission on the main menu we have also patched fighting once again to make the game more enjoyable. Unknown beach will be available soon along with online play.

notes.title: Big Patch Update
notes.content: Bugs in the fighting should be updated we will continue to patch fighting.

notes.title: Side Mission Update
notes.content: There is now a side mission available on the main menu. The fighting was also patched again as well for better performance. Online mode is still being developed and should be available soon.

notes.title: UI and AI update
notes.content: The run punch and run kick have been patched along with some improvements to the UI. Online quick match coming soon.

notes.title: Improved fighting
notes.content: Improved AI
